sqlMap.insert: INSERT INTO TD_ORGANIZATION ( org_id, org_name, org_code, parent_org_id, org_type, description, created_time, created_by, updated_time, updated_by, status, remark ) VALUES ( #[orgId], #[orgName], #[orgCode], #[parentOrgId], #[orgType], #[description], #[createdTime], #[createdBy], #[updatedTime], #[updatedBy], #[status], #[remark] )
sqlMap.select: SELECT org_id, org_name, org_code, parent_org_id, org_type, description, created_time, created_by, updated_time, updated_by, status, remark FROM TD_ORGANIZATION WHERE org_id = ? AND status != 'DELETED'
sqlMap.update: UPDATE TD_ORGANIZATION SET org_name = #[orgName], org_code = #[orgCode], parent_org_id = #[parentOrgId], org_type = #[orgType], description = #[description], updated_time = #[updatedTime], updated_by = #[updatedBy], status = #[status], remark = #[remark] WHERE org_id = #[orgId]
sqlMap.delete: UPDATE TD_ORGANIZATION SET status = 'DELETED', updated_time = NOW() WHERE org_id = ?
sqlMap.select: SELECT org_id, org_name, org_code, parent_org_id, org_type, description, created_time, created_by, updated_time, updated_by, status, remark FROM TD_ORGANIZATION WHERE parent_org_id = ? AND status != 'DELETED' ORDER BY created_time ASC

SELECT org_id, org_name, org_code, parent_org_id, org_type, description, created_time, created_by, updated_time, updated_by, status, remark FROM TD_ORGANIZATION WHERE status != 'DELETED' #if($orgType) AND org_type = #[orgType] #end ORDER BY created_time ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TD_ORGANIZATION WHERE parent_org_id = ? AND status != 'DELETED'
sqlMap.delete: DELETE FROM TD_USER_ORGANIZATION WHERE user_id = ? AND org_id = ?
sqlMap.select: SELECT o.org_id, o.org_name, o.org_code, o.parent_org_id, o.org_type, o.description, o.created_time, o.created_by, o.updated_time, o.updated_by, o.status, o.remark FROM TD_ORGANIZATION o INNER JOIN TD_USER_ORGANIZATION uo ON o.org_id = uo.org_id WHERE uo.user_id = ? AND o.status != 'DELETED' ORDER BY uo.is_primary DESC, o.created_time ASC

SELECT uo.user_id, uo.org_id, uo.is_primary, uo.created_time, uo.created_by FROM TD_USER_ORGANIZATION uo INNER JOIN TD_ORGANIZATION o ON o.org_id = uo.org_id WHERE uo.user_id = ? AND o.status != 'DELETED'
sqlMap.update: UPDATE TD_USER_ORGANIZATION SET is_primary = CASE WHEN org_id = ? THEN '1' ELSE '0' END WHERE user_id = ?
